description: This file defines a database migration class for version 5.0 beta of OrangeHRM, implementing schema upgrades, data insertions, and configuration updates related to the installation and setup of the software. It includes methods for renaming columns, adding new columns, creating tables, updating menu items, home pages, email templates, report display fields, and other configuration-related data manipulations.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A database migration class for updating the OrangeHRM schema and data for version 5.0 beta, extending AbstractMigration.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps: schema changes, data insertions, table creations, updates on menu items, homepage configuration, email templates, report display fields, filter fields, and other settings.

methods.name: updateHomePage
methods.description: Updates the homepage URL for a specified user role.

methods.name: getEmailIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the email ID from the database given its name.

methods.name: updateEmailProcessorClassByEmailName
methods.description: Updates the class associated with a specific email template.

methods.name: updateEmailTemplateSubjectAndBodyByEmailNameAndRecipientRole
methods.description: Sets the subject and body templates for a specified email and recipient role.

methods.name: getReportDisplayGroupId
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a report display field group by name.

methods.name: updateReportDisplayFieldByGroup
methods.description: Updates the class name for all display fields within a group.

methods.name: updateReportFilterFieldByFieldName
methods.description: Updates the class name for a report filter field identified by its name.

methods.name: renameReportDisplayFieldAlias
methods.description: Renames the alias of a report display field.

methods.name: renameSelectedReportFilterFieldWhereCondition
methods.description: Renames the where condition value for selected report filter fields.

methods.name: updateReportDisplayFieldByFieldAlias
methods.description: Updates the class name for a report display field identified by its alias.

methods.name: updateScreenModuleId
methods.description: Updates the module ID associated with a screen identified by its URL and name.

methods.name: updateMenuItemIconNames
methods.description: Updates the icon name for a menu item by its title.
